title: Racket Stringing Service Missing Metadata Exception Rate
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stringing:service
| where required_fields_missing=*
| stats sum(required_fields_missing) as missing_fields count as items by racket_name
| eval avg_missing=round(missing_fields/items,2)
| where avg_missing>0
| sort - avg_missing
description: Highlights racket stringing service records that routinely arrive with required fields missing.
value: Bad metadata is why personal admin trackers become untrustworthy, so exception rate is a useful hygiene metric.
implementation: Count missing required fields during ingest and write the total into `required_fields_missing` for each record.
visualization: Table of racket values by average missing fields per record.
grandmaExplanation: It builds where the records behind racket stringing service are missing important details and need cleanup.
